content.title: About
content.content: Tuna salad with mayonnaise is a ready‑to‑eat dish made from cooked or canned tuna mixed with a creamy mayonnaise dressing. It offers a mild fish flavor combined with a rich, smooth texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Tuna is one of the richest natural sources of omega‑3 fatty acids.
Traditionally, tuna salad is served as a cold appetizer or sandwich filling.
Mayonnaise is typically emulsified from egg yolk, vegetable oil, and vinegar or lemon juice.
Many variations exist, adding corn, boiled eggs, herbs, or vegetables.

items.title: Rich in omega‑3
items.content: Omega‑3 fatty acids support heart health, reduce inflammation, and aid brain function.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Tuna provides all essential amino acids, essential for muscle repair and growth.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The salad supplies B12, niacin, and riboflavin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: Tuna contains selenium, iodine, and magnesium, which support immunity and thyroid function.

items.title: Satiety
items.content: The combination of protein and fat makes the salad filling and suitable for post‑workout recovery.

items.title: Fish allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to fish may experience reactions ranging from mild to anaphylaxis.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Canned tuna often contains added salt; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Mayonnaise quality
items.content: Commercial mayonnaise can be high in saturated fats; choose versions made with healthier oils or reduced‑fat options.

items.title: Bacterial growth risk
items.content: Store the salad refrigerated and consume within 2‑3 days to prevent bacterial proliferation.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Tuna salad with mayonnaise is convenient as a snack, sandwich spread, on lettuce leaves, in wraps, or as a filling for vegetable dishes. Adding fresh veggies, herbs, or a squeeze of lemon brightens the flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in the refrigerator at 0‑4 °C. Once opened, use within 2‑3 days. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
